blocks.text: The Holport Wall Art Set turns blank walls into a curated gallery moment with two framed canvases in soothing neutral blues. Ideal as living room wall art or modern wall art in an entryway, each piece adds depth without overwhelming your decor. Hang them four ways to fit tricky layouts or style above a console for an instant update. Their versatile tones make it easy to mix with other wall art decor while helping your space feel calm and pulled together.

items.label: CASUAL DINING ROOM CHAIRS
items.value: Enjoy the classic design of these X back chairs in any bistro, eat-in kitchen or apartment space for a taste of easy-breezy dining. You'll love their timeless appeal

items.label: HANDSOMELY CRAFTED
items.value: Made of wood with a foam gray cushioned seat upholstered in polyester

items.label: ALL IN THE DETAILS
items.value: The distressed nutmeg finish and nailhead trim come together beautifully to elevate dinner at the table, even for drop in guests

items.label: SET OF 2
items.value: Each chair measures 19.5" W x 23.5" D x 39" H
